import unittest
from subject import fixture


class VaultWriteLockContractTest(unittest.TestCase):
    # 判準來源：題目給的鎖規格（可重入、不可信時改用筆記庫自己的鎖、不寫外部快取、離開最外層後釋放）

    def test_normal_lock_held_inside_and_released_after(self):
        # 輸入：normal 模式取一次鎖 / 預期：鎖內 held=True，離開後 False
        # 應抓到的錯誤：根本沒上鎖、離開後沒釋放
        with fixture("normal") as s:
            self.assertFalse(s.fallback_ready())
            self.assertFalse(s.held())
            with s.lock():
                self.assertTrue(s.held())
            self.assertFalse(s.held())

    def test_normal_nested_lock_is_reentrant_and_released_only_after_outermost(self):
        # 預期：巢狀取鎖不卡住（卡住時 fixture 在 2 秒內拋 AssertionError）；離開內層後仍持有鎖
        # 應抓到的錯誤：自己卡自己、離開內層就提早釋放
        with fixture("normal") as s:
            with s.lock():
                with s.lock():
                    self.assertTrue(s.held())
                self.assertTrue(s.held())
            self.assertFalse(s.held())

    def test_cache_moved_precondition_primary_untrusted(self):
        # 先確認情境真的成立：cache-moved 時主要快取路徑不可信
        with fixture("cache-moved") as s:
            self.assertTrue(s.fallback_ready())

    def test_cache_moved_still_locks_and_does_not_write_external_cache(self):
        # 預期：不可信時仍然上鎖（改用筆記庫自己的鎖），而且不在外部快取目錄寫鎖
        # 應抓到的錯誤：不可信時乾脆不鎖、仍把鎖檔寫到外部目錄
        with fixture("cache-moved") as s:
            self.assertTrue(s.fallback_ready())
            with s.lock():
                self.assertTrue(s.held())
                self.assertFalse(s.external_written())
            self.assertFalse(s.held())
            self.assertFalse(s.external_written())

    def test_cache_moved_nested_lock_is_reentrant(self):
        # 預期：改用備援鎖時，巢狀取鎖一樣可重入
        # 應抓到的錯誤：重入檢查用主要路徑的鍵查，而持有紀錄記在備援路徑的鍵上
        # → 內層又去搶自己的備援鎖而卡住（實作第 17 行用改路徑前的 k 判斷）
        with fixture("cache-moved") as s:
            self.assertTrue(s.fallback_ready())
            with s.lock():
                with s.lock():
                    self.assertTrue(s.held())
                    self.assertFalse(s.external_written())
                self.assertTrue(s.held())
            self.assertFalse(s.held())
            self.assertFalse(s.external_written())

    def test_cache_moved_lock_can_be_reacquired_after_release(self):
        # 預期：離開後確實釋放，同一程序可以再取一次
        # 應抓到的錯誤：備援鎖檔沒刪掉，下一次取鎖卡住
        with fixture("cache-moved") as s:
            with s.lock():
                pass
            self.assertFalse(s.held())
            with s.lock():
                self.assertTrue(s.held())
            self.assertFalse(s.held())

    def test_normal_lock_can_be_reacquired_after_release(self):
        with fixture("normal") as s:
            with s.lock():
                pass
            self.assertFalse(s.held())
            with s.lock():
                self.assertTrue(s.held())
            self.assertFalse(s.held())
